g.text: Heart pocket: finish one region, then the next
Actual tool-center paths · 4 mm cutter · 2 mm stepover · one depth · inside-out
After: each lobe finishes in sequence
Before: the expanding contour revisits both upper lobes.
After: numbered groups finish before the next starts.
Links stay down only along already-cut boundaries; other transfers retract to safe Z. Repeat the full plan at each depth.
